name: roominset-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for `roomInset` (pro tier, PARITY-ROOM-INSET): the 2D plan editor's 'Inset −0.1 m' / 'Grow +0.1 m' buttons in the RoomInspector (`.plan-props`), shown only with a room selected. Simple: the room properties panel shows no inset/grow controls at all (even with a room selected). Pro: selecting the largest room (Living/Dining, avoids a collapse-reject on a narrow room) and clicking 'Inset −0.1 m' calls the real `insetRoom` op (an actual `insetPolygon` offset of the room outline, not a placeholder), visibly shrinking the room boundary on the plan — asserted via the room's live polygon/width/depth in the store, then undone back to the original outline.

steps.name: assert-flag-off-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const f = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.roomInset; if (f !== false) throw new Error('roomInset should resolve false in Simple mode, got ' + f); })()

steps.name: select-largest-room
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); const rooms = s.floorPlan.rooms; if (!rooms.length) throw new Error('no rooms in the default plan'); const biggest = rooms.reduce((a, b) => (a.width * a.depth >= b.width * b.depth ? a : b)); window.__roomId = biggest.id; window.__wd0 = { w: biggest.width, d: biggest.depth }; s.setPlanSelection({ type: 'room', id: biggest.id }); })()

steps.name: assert-hidden-in-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-props'); if (!panel) throw new Error('.plan-props panel missing'); const t = panel.textContent||''; if (t.includes('Inset') || t.includes('Grow +')) throw new Error('inset/grow controls visible in Simple mode — roomInset is pro-tier and should be hidden'); })()

steps.name: assert-flag-on-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const f = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.roomInset; if (f !== true) throw new Error('roomInset should resolve true in Pro mode, got ' + f); })()

steps.name: reselect-room-after-mode-switch
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); if (s.planSelection?.type !== 'room' || s.planSelection.id !== window.__roomId) s.setPlanSelection({ type: 'room', id: window.__roomId }); })()

steps.name: click-inset
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-props'); const btn = panel && [...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim().startsWith('Inset')); if (!btn) throw new Error("'Inset −0.1 m' button not found"); btn.click(); })()

waitFor.store: (() => { const r = state.floorPlan.rooms.find(x => x.id === window.__roomId); return !!r && !!r.polygon; })()

steps.name: assert-room-smaller
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); const r = s.floorPlan.rooms.find(x => x.id === window.__roomId); if (!r || !r.polygon) throw new Error('room lost its polygon after inset'); if (!(r.width < window.__wd0.w) && !(r.depth < window.__wd0.d)) throw new Error('bounding box did not shrink after inset: ' + JSON.stringify({ before: window.__wd0, after: { w: r.width, d: r.depth } })); })()

waitFor.store: (() => { const r = state.floorPlan.rooms.find(x => x.id === window.__roomId); return !!r && Math.abs(r.width - window.__wd0.w) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(r.depth - window.__wd0.d) < 1e-6; })()

steps.name: assert-flag-off-again
steps.eval: (function(){ const f = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.roomInset; if (f !== false) throw new Error('roomInset should resolve false back in Simple mode, got ' + f); })()

steps.name: assert-hidden-again
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-props'); if (!panel) throw new Error('.plan-props panel missing'); const t = panel.textContent||''; if (t.includes('Inset') || t.includes('Grow +')) throw new Error('inset/grow controls visible back in Simple mode'); })()
